decides: 기존 코드의 관찰 가능한 동작을 바꾸지 않고 안전하게 재구조화할 수 있는가
produces: refactoring plan, characterization tests, before/after behavior-equivalence note

degree_level_knowledge.concept: Fowler's refactoring catalog and code smells

degree_level_knowledge.source: Feathers, Working Effectively with Legacy Code (Prentice Hall 2004)

deliverable_form.method: Named refactoring from Fowler's catalog applied with before/after diff citing the catalog entry

feedback_methodology.method: Characterization-test-first review: does a change to untested legacy code add a characterization test before altering behavior
feedback_methodology.source: Feathers, Working Effectively with Legacy Code (Prentice Hall 2004)

judgment_methodology.method: Fowler's code-smell catalog to identify what actually warrants refactoring versus stylistic preference

planning_methodology.method: Strangler Fig incremental-replacement plan for legacy surfaces with no test coverage

quality_bar.verification_method: automated check that motivation names an actual entry from Fowler's code-smell catalog, not a bare stylistic preference statement
quality_bar.verified_source: Fowler & Beck, Refactoring: Improving the Design of Existing Code, 2nd ed (Addison-Wesley 2018) — 24-entry code-smell catalog (primary source; confirmed via secondary survey https://codesai.com/posts/2022/11/code-smells-taxonomies-and-catalogs-english). Criterion correctly requires citing an actual catalog entry, not a bare stylistic preference.

quality_bar.verification_method: automated check that the full test suite passes before and after mechanics is applied with unchanged assertions on unrelated tests (diff of test-file assertions outside the touched surface is empty)
quality_bar.verified_source: No single named canonical source in the spec; this is standard refactoring discipline stated throughout Fowler's Refactoring (the book's core definition: refactoring changes structure without changing observable behavior) but the specific mechanic (diff of test-file assertions outside the touched surface) is an implementation detail, not a quoted rule from the book. Kept as practitioner-consensus.

quality_bar.verification_method: human-review-checklist: if the touched legacy code had no pre-existing test coverage, was a characterization test added before mechanics changed behavior, per Feathers' characterization-test-first rule?
quality_bar.verified_source: Michael Feathers, Working Effectively with Legacy Code (Prentice Hall 2004) — characterization-test-first is the book's own documented technique for getting untested code under a harness before changing it (confirmed via secondary summary https://daedtech.com/characterization-tests/).

quality_bar.verification_method: human-review-checklist: does the refactor introduce or use a seam (per Feathers) rather than editing untestable code directly in place?
quality_bar.verified_source: Michael Feathers, Working Effectively with Legacy Code (Prentice Hall 2004) — seam is the book's own defined term ('a place where you can alter behavior without editing in that place'), confirmed via Fowler's bliki restatement https://martinfowler.com/bliki/LegacySeam.html.

quality_bar.verification_method: gates/quality_bar.py:human_comprehensibility_verdict against the role's own docs/issue-<n>/reports/<role>.md record text (gates/human_comprehensibility.py tier-1 structural prose rules: lead paragraph present, citation trailing placement, section size bound, no raw dump, enumeration cap); a record with no human-facing prose section anywhere is exempt (bar-met) -- issue #1623.

recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)
recomputation.rule: verdict is recomputed by re-running the test suite after mechanics is applied, never a standalone asserted field.

reference_resolution.rule: refactoring_name must resolve to an actual entry in Fowler's catalog — no invented refactoring names (issue-515 invariant 2).

review_methodology.method: Seam identification review: confirm the refactor introduces or uses a seam rather than editing untestable code directly
review_methodology.source: Feathers, Working Effectively with Legacy Code (Prentice Hall 2004)

use_when.board_condition: a code smell is flagged on the branch AND no refactoring-legacy record exists yet for that smell

use_when: 레거시/기존 코드에 손을 대야 할 때 (b) scope overlap, tentative: implementation의 write_scope가 이미 이 도메인을 inline으로 커버하는 경우 별도 record는 생략 가능 — 레거시-부채 전용 record 타입이 별도로 필요해지면 재검토 (issue #993 product-discovery diagnosis)
